name: OrioleOne Compliance Assessment
author: OrioleOne

sections.description:
OrioleOne Compliance Assessment evaluates Cisco IOS XE configuration data against benchmark-defined controls.

The plugin preserves a benchmark-driven architecture with:

  • Dynamic benchmark loading from JSON datasets.
  • Parser and rule engine separation.
  • Level 1 and Level 2 assessment workflows.
  • Reporting and export support.
  • Security-first admin workflows with capability and nonce enforcement.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open Compliance Assessment from the admin menu.
sections.changelog:
1.0.1

  • Brand: Standardized display name and brand references to single-word “OrioleOne”.
  • Security: Injected ABSPATH execution guards across all class and interface files.
  • Security: Hardened database aggregate and existence queries with strict $wpdb->prepare calls.
  • Performance: Eliminated synchronous admin_init benchmark sync bottleneck using transient caching.
  • Performance: Enforced autoload discipline on internal options table registrations.
  • Standards: Corrected CSS specificity order and resolved all stylelint violations.
  • WordPress Core: Verified compatibility with WordPress 7.1.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
